question: What is the meaning of impacts on human health in relation to use of substances?
description: Impacts on human health in relation to the use of substances refer to the effects that certain substances can have on human well-being. This includes substances that can cause cancer, genetic mutations, harm fertility or the unborn child, disrupt the hormonal system, target specific organs, affect respiratory health, cause skin sensitization or allergic reactions.
